sourceBoundParaphrase.en: Attitude Number is described as the initial way a person approaches people, situations and unexpected change; this role is distinct from how others perceive the person.
sourceBoundParaphrase.zhHans: 态度数被描述为进入人物、情境及意外变化时的初始应对方式；这一角色与“别人怎么看你”不同。

sourceBoundParaphrase.en: The source distinguishes different compound paths that reduce to the same number; PHI therefore keeps rawValue and reduction path visible as evidence instead of treating all equal reduced values as identical.
